suresh: Heads-up — Ventana-v1 internal rollout scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PST. Staging perf shows ~2.8x tokens/sec vs our baseline for 512-seq workloads. Rough forecast: sustained +85k t/s globally, short peaks up to +240k t/s in first 48h. Need quick sanity check on GPU-hours, region quotas, and network egress. Any blockers?
anya: Where are those numbers from? link to perf run: https://perf.internal/runs/ventana-0426. What's the seq length distribution we used?
suresh: Perf run used a mixed traffic sim (median 512, 90th 1300). Numbers come from p95 routing mix + concurrency of 12 per host. p99 latency ~180ms on g5x2-equivalent config. I ran a conservative tokens->GPU mapping for planning.
suresh: Quick calc I used (informal):
```
# rough calc
peak_tokens_s = 240000
tokens_per_gpu_s = 4000  # conservative observed in staging with batching
needed_gpus = ceil(peak_tokens_s / tokens_per_gpu_s)  # ~= 60
# incremental GPU-hours over 48h ~= 60 * 48 = 2880 GPU-hours
```
lee: FYI eu-west-1 quota is tight — we only have ~300 GPUs total there and many are pinned to Dedicated customers. We can't absorb 60 extra on short notice in that region. Suggest primary traffic to us-west-2 + autoscale to spot pools, and failover to canary model variant if capacity hits threshold.
marta: Ballpark cost for incremental capacity: if we assume on-demand $6/hr -> 2880 * $6 ~= $17.3k for 48h. With 60/40 spot mix we can aim for ~$10.4k. Add ~10% for networking/egress.
ops-bot: [ALERT] cluster-eu-west-1-gpu-pool at 88% allocation (tracked by quota-watch). No active OOMs.
noah: Two mitigations to reduce GPUs: 1) enable prefix KV caching on the most common prompts — should shave ~30-45% token generation for chat flows; 2) push a lower-precision quantized variant for heavy routes (benchmarks show ~1.6x speed improvement). Combined could cut needed GPUs to ~25-35.
anya: If we stage rollout (10% traffic -> 30% -> 100%) over 6 hours, we can monitor real t/s and fail fast. Also recommend changing routing policy to route heavy seqs to regions with spare capacity.
suresh: Action items: 1) noah + lee to surface region capacity map and quota gaps by EOD; 2) infra to prepare autoscale policy + spot fallback runbook; 3) marta to approve emergency budget (~$12k) for 48h; 4) I'll update the Ventana runbook with staged rollout and prefix-caching toggles.
suresh: If we can get a quick estimate on realistic tokens_per_gpu_s with caching enabled, we can finalize GPU commit. Ping me if you need extra numbers. :thumbsup:
